escenas.texto: Which was the most viewed video in Oceania this week? Here is the podium. Watch until the end.
In third place, Rate our DANCE? 🕺 @SofiManassyan, by NickandCarrie, with over 10 million views.
In second place, WE ARE SO CLOSE TO 5M 🤯 CAN YOU GUYS HELP US HIT IT? 🥹🥰, by Double Trouble Squad, with over 12 million views.
And number one: How you invented blinds!, by Odd Tilt, with over 18 million views.
The full countdown, from ten to one, is already on the channel. Find it in the description. Hashtag Top 10 RS.
